# R4EwE

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

**R4EwE** ("R for Ecopath with Ecosim") is a collection of utilities, workflows,
and helpers for [Ecopath with Ecosim (EwE)](https://ecopath.org/) modellers. It
grew out of spatial-temporal calibration work on the Northwest Atlantic
Continental Shelf (NWACS) and West Florida Shelf (WFS) ecosystem models, and
bundles the recurring steps of a modern EwE workflow into documented functions.

Broadly, the package covers:

- **Environmental driver extraction** — pull and process ocean/climate reanalysis
  and forecast products (CEFI, Copernicus GLORYS, ESA-CCI) into the monthly ASCII
  driver grids that Ecospace consumes (`fn.pull_cefi`, `fn.pull_glorys`,
  `fn.pull_esacci`, `fn.netcdf2ascii_*`, `fn.make_monthly_climatology_maps`).
- **Running EwE from R** — drive the EwE console: build command files, launch
  runs, and parallelise batches (`fn.make_cmd_files`, `fn.runEwE.parallel`).
- **Genetic-algorithm calibration** — calibrate Ecospace/Ecosim parameters
  (vulnerabilities, dispersal, environmental responses) with a GA engine
  (`fn.GApop`, `crossover`, `mutate`, `select_parents`, `tournament_select`,
  `archive_ga`).
- **Objective functions & likelihoods** — timeseries lognormal negative
  log-likelihood plus a spatial cross-entropy term (`fn.ecospace_objfxn`,
  `fn.spatial_LL`, `fn.objfxn1`).
- **Reading output & plotting fits** — parse Ecosim/Ecospace predictions and plot
  them against observed time series and maps (`fn.read_ecosim_timeseries`,
  `fn.ecospace_plot_fits`, `fn.ecosim_plot_fits`, `fn.ecospace_spatial_pred`).
- **Species distributions & survey data** — AquaMaps distribution shapes and MDAT
  biomass loaders (`fn.make_aquamaps_shapes`, `fn.load_mdat_biomass`).

See the [PDF reference manual](R4EwE_manual.pdf) for every function and its
arguments.

## Installation

Install the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/dchagaris/R4EwE)
with either `remotes` or `pak`:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("dchagaris/R4EwE")

# or
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("dchagaris/R4EwE")
```

Some functions rely on **Suggested** packages that are not installed
automatically (e.g. `aquamapsdata`, `DBI`/`RSQLite`, `dplyr`); install those as
needed for the workflow you are using. Running EwE models additionally requires a
local EwE installation, which R4EwE calls as an external application.

## Usage

```r
library(R4EwE)

# List everything the package exports
ls("package:R4EwE")

# Open help for any function
?fn.GApop
```

Worked examples for full calibration and driver-extraction workflows live in the
[`examples/`](examples) and [`inst/examples/`](inst/examples) folders of the
repository.

## Getting help and reporting issues
